title: Agriculture Equipment Service Technician - Skill Training Batch
provider: Nashik District Agri Skill Centre, Sinnar
description: Four month certified training for agricultural equipment service technicians. Covers routine servicing, fault diagnosis, pump and irrigation equipment repair, engine overhaul, testing and workplace safety. Practical work on pump sets, tillers and power tillers in the centre workshop.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass. Basic reading and writing in Marathi or Hindi. No prior certification needed.
source: District Skill Development Centre listing (prototype seed data)

training_program.funding_notes: No fee for this batch. Tool kit provided on completion of the practical assessment.
training_program.certification_offered: Sector Skill Council assessment and certificate on completion

title: Village Pump and Farm Machinery Repair Service - Micro-Enterprise Pathway
description: Supported pathway to set up a village level pump and farm machinery repair service. Combines technical upskilling with costing, spare parts stocking, customer handling and basic accounts. Suited to someone already doing informal repair work who wants to formalise and grow it without leaving the village.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass. Existing practical repair experience is counted. Applicant must be resident in the block.
source: Block Livelihoods Resource Centre listing (prototype seed data)

title: Farm Equipment Service Technician
description: Service technician for a farm equipment dealership workshop. Day to day work is servicing pump sets, power tillers and sprayers, diagnosing faults reported by farmers, and field visits within the taluka.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass with practical repair experience, or a completed equipment service technician certificate.
source: Employer listing verified by district placement cell (prototype seed data)

title: Apprenticeship - Tractor and Farm Machinery Mechanic
description: Twelve month apprenticeship in a tractor and implement repair workshop. Structured rotation through servicing, hydraulics, engine work and fault diagnosis under a qualified mechanic, with a monthly stipend.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass. Candidate must be able to attend the workshop six days a week.
source: Employer apprenticeship listing (prototype seed data)

title: Mechanical Technician - Pump Assembly and Testing Line
description: Assembly and testing technician on a submersible and monoblock pump production line. Work involves mechanical assembly, alignment, hydraulic testing, fault diagnosis on rejected units and measurement to specification. Experienced pump repair candidates are specifically encouraged to apply.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass. Two years of hands-on pump or machinery repair experience. Candidate must be willing to relocate to Pune; shared accommodation is offered.
source: Employer listing verified by placement partner (prototype seed data)

title: Solar Pump Installation Technician - Training
description: Training in siting, mounting, wiring and commissioning solar powered pump sets for irrigation, including electrical safety and fault rectification. Strong fit for candidates who already understand conventional pump sets.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass. Some prior experience with pumps or electrical work is preferred but not mandatory.
source: Training provider listing verified by district skill cell (prototype seed data)

training_program.funding_notes: Partial fee support available. Confirm current terms with the centre before enrolling.
training_program.certification_offered: Sector Skill Council assessment on completion

title: Agricultural Machinery Operator - Training
description: Short course on safe operation of tractors, tillers, harvesters and irrigation systems with first line maintenance. Entry level, open to candidates with 8th standard.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass. Applicants must be able to attend day sessions.
source: Extension centre listing (prototype seed data)

training_program.certification_offered: Centre completion certificate with Sector Skill Council assessment option

title: Irrigation Pump Fitter
description: Fitter for borewell and canal pump installations. Work is on-site installation, alignment and commissioning of pump sets with a two person crew.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass with pump handling experience.
source: Employer listing, self declared and not yet independently verified (prototype seed data)

title: Custom Hiring Centre Operator - Self Employment
description: Operate a custom hiring centre renting farm machinery to smallholders in surrounding villages. Requires machinery operation and first line maintenance skill plus basic record keeping and customer handling.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass. Applicant must be resident in the block and able to arrange a storage yard.
source: Block Agriculture Office demonstration listing (prototype seed data)

title: Farm Machinery Maintenance - Short Course (batch closed)
description: Short course on farm machinery servicing and hydraulics. This record is deliberately kept in the seed data with a past validity date so that expiry filtering can be demonstrated: it must never appear as an active recommendation.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass.
source: Polytechnic extension listing (prototype seed data)

title: Agri-Business Extension Associate
description: Field associate advising member farmers on production practice, input planning and market linkage. Included in the seed data to demonstrate education based eligibility filtering: it requires a degree.
eligibility_notes: Graduate, preferably in agriculture or a related subject. Two-wheeler licence required.
source: Producer company listing (prototype seed data)

title: Pump Set Operator Certification (legacy standard)
description: Legacy pump operator certification mapped to a retired qualification. Kept in the seed data to demonstrate that a pathway built on a retired standard is excluded from recommendations with an explicit reason.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass.
source: Regional vocational board legacy listing (prototype seed data)

title: Welder - Fabrication Unit
description: Arc welder for a structural fabrication workshop producing gates, frames and trolleys. Shift work with overtime.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass with demonstrable welding skill. A trade test is conducted at hiring.
source: Employer listing, self declared (prototype seed data)

title: Two-Wheeler Service Technician - Training
description: Training in periodic service and repair of motorcycles and scooters, including engine work, brakes and electricals. Included to show how a related but different sector ranks against an agriculture-mechanical profile.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass.
source: Training provider listing (prototype seed data)

training_program.certification_offered: Sector Skill Council assessment on completion

title: Farm Machinery Helper (position filled)
description: Helper role in a machinery yard. Marked inactive in the seed data to demonstrate that inactive listings are excluded from recommendations even when they are nearby and otherwise a good fit.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass.
source: Employer listing (prototype seed data)

title: Equipment Maintenance Refresher (unverified for over a year)
description: Refresher module on equipment maintenance. This record has not been re-verified for more than a year and is kept in the seed data to demonstrate hard staleness exclusion: a listing nobody has confirmed recently must not be presented as available.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass.
source: Regional training partner listing (prototype seed data)

title: Electric Motor Rewinding - Training
description: Training in stripping, rewinding, varnishing and testing single and three phase motors, including agricultural pump motors. Useful adjacent skill for pump repair workers who want to take on motor faults themselves.
eligibility_notes: 10th standard pass.
source: Industrial training institute listing (prototype seed data)

training_program.certification_offered: Institute certificate with Sector Skill Council assessment option

title: Tailoring and Garment Alteration Unit - Self Employment
description: Set up a small garment stitching and alteration unit. Included in the seed data as a deliberately unrelated sector, so that an agriculture-mechanical profile can be seen to rank it low even though it is the closest listing of all.
eligibility_notes: 8th standard pass. Own or rented machine required.
source: Mahila Udyog Kendra demonstration listing (prototype seed data)

title: Junior Software Developer - Python & Java
description: Junior developer role working on backend APIs, data processing scripts with Python, and application modules in Java. Freshers with programming skills welcome.
eligibility_notes: 12th pass, diploma or graduate with knowledge of Python or Java.
source: NASSCOM FutureSkills job partner registry

title: Full-Stack Web Development - FutureSkills
description: Intensive government-subsidised certification in web development, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, and Python backend APIs.
eligibility_notes: 12th standard pass or higher.
source: National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)

training_program.certification_offered: NSQF Level 5 Certificate with NASSCOM assessment

title: IT Helpdesk & System Support Apprentice
description: On-the-job apprenticeship supporting district portal operations, PC diagnostics, hardware troubleshooting, and network support.
eligibility_notes: 10th pass with basic computer familiarity.
source: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)

title: CAD Draughtsman & Engineering Technician
description: Preparation of engineering drawings, parts modelling, and technical drafting using CAD software for infrastructure projects.
eligibility_notes: 10th pass with ITI or diploma drafting skills.
source: Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC) employer portal
